title: Ruff, Roar & Rejoice! Volume 2
description: Round two for little ones! More Avengers heroes, fun animals, Bluey friends, brave Bible champions, worship songs, and your favorite rescue pups and movie animals.

questions.question: This Avenger has long red hair and can do amazing flips and kicks! She has no superpowers — just super spy skills — and she is one of the toughest fighters on the whole team!
This Avenger can make things float in the air using her glowing red hands! She has incredible magic powers and is one of the most powerful heroes in the entire Marvel universe.
This big, friendly hero is made entirely of wood and vines! He can only say his own name — three simple words — but even so, he is one of the bravest and most lovable heroes ever.
This hero wears a cool eye patch over one of his eyes and leads a top secret superhero organization called S.H.I.E.L.D. He is the man who brought all the Avengers together as a team!
This Avenger is actually a robot called an android! He has a shiny golden gem on his forehead and the amazing ability to fly right through solid walls.
This fluffy four-legged friend is called man's best friend! It barks to say hello, wags its tail when happy, and loves to play fetch and give big sloppy kisses.
This cozy furry animal says MEOW and loves to purr! It has soft little whiskers on its face and cleans itself by licking its own fur like a little grooming expert.
This cute little animal has two very long ears, a tiny fluffy cottontail, and loves to hop all around! It is also a big fan of munching on crunchy orange carrots.
This animal lives underwater and breathes through special things called gills instead of lungs! It has scales covering its body and fins to help it swim gracefully through the water.
This tall and beautiful animal can gallop really fast and has a long flowing mane and tail that blow in the wind. People love to ride it, and it says NEIGH!
This puppy is one of Bluey's best school friends and loves to run and play sports! She is very fast and active — always on the move!
This boy puppy is one of Bluey's fun friends! He is a small energetic white dog with SO much energy — always bouncing around. He and Bluey love going on big adventures together.
This is Bluey's uncle! He is Bandit's brother, which makes him a very special part of the whole Heeler family.
This is Bluey and Bingo's grandma! She loves her little granddaughters very much and is always happy to see them.
On the Bluey show, the kids are always doing this — making up fun stories, becoming characters, and acting everything out together. What do we call this magical type of play?
This brave Bible leader marched his people around a big city seven times, then blew trumpets and gave a mighty SHOUT — and the huge walls came tumbling down because God was with them!
This woman in the Bible cried out to God and prayed very hard for a baby. God heard her prayer and gave her a son named Samuel! She loved God so much she gave her son back to serve Him.
These special visitors in the Bible followed a big bright star all the way across the land to find baby Jesus! They brought Him wonderful gifts including gold and sweet-smelling spices.

These three brave friends in the Bible refused to bow down to a giant golden statue. The angry king threw them into a super hot fiery furnace — but God kept them perfectly safe and they were not even burned!
questions.answer: Who are Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego?

questions.question: This mighty angel from God appeared to Mary to tell her the most amazing news ever — that she would be the mother of Jesus, the Son of God! This same angel also visited Zechariah.

Phil Wickham wrote this famous worship song that begins 'What can wash away my sin? Nothing but the blood of Jesus.' Wait — actually, his most famous song starts 'This is...' What are the next two words?

Phil Wickham wrote this joyful worship song about gathering together to praise God in His special holy place. Everyone sings it together with big smiles. The title starts with 'House of the...' — what is the last word?

Ellie Holcomb wrote this gentle, comforting song for anyone going through a really hard or scary time. The song promises that God is always there to be found, no matter what. What is this song called?
Phil Wickham wrote this beautiful song that says God is not only amazing today, but will be holy and wonderful forever and ever — without end! What is this powerful song called?
Phil Wickham and Ellie Holcomb have each won trophies at this special awards show just for Christian music — like the Grammys, but only for worship and gospel songs. What is this award called?
This PAW Patrol pup wears a pink outfit and zooms around in her very own pink helicopter! She is super brave and loves flying high in the sky to help with rescues.
This chubby bulldog pup on PAW Patrol drives a big yellow construction vehicle and loves helping build things! He is also really good at eating snacks and having fun.
This green PAW Patrol pup cares deeply about taking care of the Earth! He helps by recycling and reusing things, and he loves to build clever gadgets out of old stuff.
In Zootopia, this extremely slow sloth works at the vehicle licensing counter and tells jokes in the most hilariously slow way possible — making it one of the funniest scenes in the movie!
In Zootopia, this small fluffy sheep seemed so sweet and helpful as the assistant mayor — but she was secretly the real villain behind all the trouble in the city the whole time!
